column3: 22% of schools have no usable outcome; -11 data-quality suppression is not random
column5: 21,493 of 97,575 rows (22.0%) have an undefined rate; 14,166 (14.5%) are -11 (suppressed) and are concentrated by state (Hawaii 100%, Florida 54%, Nevada 51%, North Carolina 42%, Maryland 38%, New York 36%...). Those states report little seclusion in other years, so the analysis sample over-represents high-reporting states. Document this prominently and provide state-level validity weights.

4,700 schools (100% of them virtual-only by the COVID indicator); 90.7% of all virtual-only schools skipped the module and only 342 of 5,189 virtual-only schools have a valid outcome. Virtual vs in-person seclusion cannot be compared fairly.

column3: File named "analysis_ready" is not filtered and has no readiness flag
column5: All 97,575 rows are kept (including the 21,493 with an undefined rate). Add a flag_analysis_ready like the 2017-18 and 2021-22 files, and drop or flag small and FTE-outlier rows consistently.

flag_fte_outlier fires on 758 schools but they stay in the file; max nurse FTE 833, max counselor FTE 205. Security FTE is -9 for 573 of 579 justice facilities (audit), so security ratios are biased for those schools.

82 analysis-ready rows have more instances than students; 76 regular schools exceed 25 per 100; max 1,714 instances (West Kearney High School, NE: 1,714 instances / 109 students). Verify against CRDC before using as labels.
88% of schools are coded hybrid, 247 have no instruction type and 6,803 no virtual type (6,482 are -13 skips). A single self-reported category cannot separate months of remote vs in-person learning.
592 schools have no usable enrollment (561 / 560 suppressed for M / F); rates and per-100 ratios are undefined for them.

column3: Schema differs from the 2017-18 and 2021-22 files
column5: 176 columns (about 100 are *_code / *_reason helpers), upper-case source names, and renamed derived fields (enrollment vs enrollment_total, seclusion_rate_per_100 vs seclusion_rate, idea_share as a 0-1 fraction vs pct_idea in 0-100). Publish one harmonised schema before pooling years.

column3: Small-enrollment flag and grade_band inconsistent across years
column5: flag_small_enrollment is enrollment < 50 here (5,702 schools) but < 10 in 2017-18 and 2021-22; neither is the right cut-off for rates (this EDA recommends 30). grade_band is not provided; derived here from SCH_GRADE_* flags.

column3: Race of secluded students and other discipline measures not carried through
column5: Required for the race equity item; physical and mechanical restraint are present (and must be excluded as leakage) but suspensions, expulsions and referrals are absent.
